question: Which of the following is an example of a joint sector industry?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Oil India Limited**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Oil India Limited (OIL)** is a joint sector company where the government collaborates with private entities to run the business.
 
• The company was established in 1959 and is a key player in the oil and gas sector in India.
 
• OIL is involved in the exploration, development, and production of crude oil and natural gas, transportation of crude oil, and production of LPG.
 
• The Government of India holds a significant share in the company, making it a joint sector enterprise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Joint Sector Enterprises**

 
 
• These are businesses where the government collaborates with private firms to undertake the establishment and operations of industries.
 
• The primary objective is to combine the resources and expertise of both sectors for effective and efficient management.
 
• Such collaborations often aim at reducing the risk involved and increasing the capital investment for large-scale projects.
 
• Examples include Oil India Limited and Maruti Udyog Limited.
 
 
 
• **Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL)**
 
 
• It is a state-owned aerospace and defense company based in India.
 
• HAL is primarily involved in the design, fabrication, and assembly of aircraft, jet engines, helicopters, and their spare parts.
 
• It operates under the administrative control of the Ministry of Defence.
 
 
 
• **National Highway Authority of India (NHAI)**
 
 
• NHAI is an autonomous agency of the Government of India, responsible for the management of a network of over 50,000 km of National Highways.
 
• It operates under the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways.
 
• NHAI is involved in the construction, management, and maintenance of highways.
 
 
 
• **Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL)**
 
 
• SAIL is one of the largest state-owned steel-making companies in India and one of the top steel makers in the world.
 
• It operates under the Ministry of Steel, Government of India.
 
• SAIL produces iron and steel at five integrated plants and three special steel plants, located principally in the eastern and central regions of India.
